description_en: Lists the members managed by the IPAM trusted service
description_zh: 查询IPAM可信服务纳管成员
kebab_example: aliyun vpcipam list-ipam-members --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --member-ids fd-ccccncASqa --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --max-results 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIpamMembers

parameters.help_en: The ID of the hosted region of the IPAM. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html operation to get the region ID
parameters.help_zh: IPAM托管地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: A list of IDs of members managed by the IPAM trusted service
parameters.help_zh: IPAM可信服务纳管成员ID列表
parameters.name: member_ids

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no more results are available.

If NextToken has a value, the value is the token for the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时返回的最多条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page
Count.description_zh: 分批次查询时返回的具体条目数

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时返回的最多条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10

MemberInfos.description_en: A list of members managed by the IPAM trusted service
MemberInfos.description_zh: IPAM可信服务纳管成员信息列表

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the member was added

MemberId.description_en:
The member ID.

Folder ID: The ID of the folder.

Account UID: The UID of the member account in the resource directory
MemberId.description_zh:
成员ID。

Folder ID：资源夹ID。

Account UID：资源目录成员账号UID

MemberType.description_en:
The type of the member. Valid values:

Folder: The member is a folder.

Account: The member is a member account in the resource directory
MemberType.description_zh:
成员类型，取值：

Folder：资源夹。

Account：资源目录成员账号

Status.description_en:
The status of the member managed by the IPAM trusted service. Valid values:

Created: The member is managed.

Deleted: The member is removed
Status.description_zh:
IPAM可信服务纳管成员的成员状态。取值：

Created：表示成员已纳管完成。
Deleted：表示成员已移除

NextToken.description_en:

If NextToken is empty, no more results are available.

If NextToken has a value, the value is the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
